exercises.instructionEn: You don't have to fly to get from Britain to central Europe. Why not cross the English Channel by boat, or go through the Channel Tunnel?
exercises.instructionUz: Britaniyadan materik Yevropaga borish uchun samolyotda uchish shart emas. La-Mansh bo'g'ozidan kema bilan o'tsangiz-chi yoki tunnel orqali borsangiz-chi?
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 'CULTURE CLIPS' BO'LIMINING
BIRINChI MAVZUSI.

  Mavzu: Britaniyadan materik Yevropaga
  qanday borish mumkin.


⚠ BET RAQAMI TIKLANDI:

  Photo File varaqlarida bet raqami yo'q
  edi (ular qirqib olinadigan varaqlar).

  Culture Clips'da raqamlash yana
  boshlanadi — 154-betdan.


KIRISh MATNI:

  'You don't have to fly to get from
   Britain to central Europe. Why not
   cross the English Channel by boat,
   or go through the Channel Tunnel?'


⚠⚠ 'DON'T HAVE TO' — MUHIM QOLIP:

  'You DON'T HAVE TO fly.'
     = Uchish ShART EMAS.
       (Uchsangiz ham bo'ladi, lekin
        majburiy emas.)

  ⚠⚠ 'MUSTN'T' BILAN ADAShTIRMANG!

     'You don't have to fly.'
        = uchish ShART EMAS (erkinlik)

     'You mustn't fly.'
        = uchish TAQIQLANADI (taqiq)

  ⚠ Bu — ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p xato
  qilinadigan juftliklardan biri.


⚠ 'WHY NOT ...?' — TAKLIF:

  'WHY NOT cross the Channel by boat?'
     = Bo'g'ozdan kema bilan o'tsangiz-chi?

  ⚠ 'Why not' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda, 'you' YO'Q:
     'Why not GO?'      ✓
     'Why not you go?'  ✗
     'Why not to go?'   ✗

  ⚠ 144-betdagi 'Why DON'T YOU go?' bilan
  ma'nosi bir xil, lekin qurilishi boshqa:
     'Why don't you GO?'  ('you' BOR)
     'Why not GO?'        ('you' YO'Q)


⚠ 'THE ENGLISH CHANNEL':

  = La-Mansh bo'g'ozi
  (Angliya bilan Fransiya orasidagi
   dengiz bo'g'ozi)

  ⚠ 'a channel' = bo'g'oz; kanal;
     telekanal

  ⚠ Fransuzlar uni 'La Manche' deydi.

  ⚠ 'the Channel Tunnel' = bo'g'oz osti
  tunneli. Xalq orasida 'the Chunnel'
  ('Channel' + 'tunnel') deb ham ataladi.


⚠ 'BY BOAT' — ARTIKLSIZ:

     by boat, by car, by train,
     by plane, by bus

  ⚠ Transport vositasi 'BY' bilan kelsa
  ARTIKL QO'YILMAYDI:
     'by boat'     ✓
     'by the boat' ✗

  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' (piyoda) —
  'by foot' EMAS!


⚠ HALOL IZOH — SARLAVHA HAQIDA:

  Sarlavhada 'CENTRAL Europe'
  (Markaziy Yevropa) deyilgan.

  Lekin matn va xaritada faqat FRANSIYA
  va BELGIYA ko'rsatilgan — bular
  G'ARBIY Yevropa mamlakatlari.

  Britaniyaliklar 'materik Yevropa'
  ma'nosida ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a route      = yo'l, marshrut
  the English Channel = La-Mansh bo'g'ozi
  the Channel Tunnel = bo'g'oz osti tunneli
  to cross     = kesib o'tmoq
  to fly       = uchmoq
  a boat       = qayiq, kema
  don't have to = shart emas

tasks.en: You don't have to fly to get from Britain to central Europe.
tasks.uz: Britaniyadan materik Yevropaga borish uchun samolyotda uchish shart emas.
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ 'DON'T HAVE TO' = ShART EMAS.

ADASHTIRMANG:
  'don't have to fly' = uchish shart emas
  'MUSTN'T fly'       = uchish TAQIQLANADI

Birinchisi — erkinlik, ikkinchisi — taqiq.

tasks.en: Why not cross the English Channel by boat?
tasks.uz: La-Mansh bo'g'ozidan kema bilan o'tsangiz-chi?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'WHY NOT' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda,
'you' QO'YILMAYDI:
  'Why not cross?'      ✓
  'Why not you cross?'  ✗

⚠ 144-betdagi 'Why don't you...?' bilan
ma'nosi bir xil, qurilishi boshqa.

tasks.en: ... or go through the Channel Tunnel?
tasks.uz: ... yoki tunnel orqali borsangiz-chi?
tasks.note:
'the Channel Tunnel' = bo'g'oz osti tunneli.

⚠ Xalq orasida 'the Chunnel' deb ataladi
('Channel' + 'tunnel').

'through' = ichidan o'tib;
'across' = ustidan/narigi tomonga.

tasks.en: by boat, by car, by train  —  BUT: on foot
tasks.uz: kema bilan, mashinada, poyezdda — LEKIN: piyoda
tasks.note:
⚠ Transport 'BY' bilan kelsa ARTIKL YO'Q:
  'by boat'     ✓

⚠⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON foot' (piyoda) —
'by foot' EMAS!

exercises.instructionEn: 1  Pre-reading Activity. Look at the pictures and the map. Which of the following are true statements? Write T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: 1  O'qishdan oldingi mashq. Rasmlarga va xaritaga qarang. Quyidagilardan qaysilari to'g'ri? T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU — 'PRE-READING ACTIVITY'
(o'qishdan OLDINGI mashq).

  Maqsadi: matnni o'qishdan oldin
  RASMLAR va XARITAGA qarab taxmin
  qilish.

  ⚠ Xarita 155-betda.


⚠ NEGA 'PRE-READING' KERAK:

  Matnni o'qishdan oldin mavzu bilan
  tanishsangiz, o'qish OSONROQ bo'ladi —
  miya nimani kutishni biladi.


⚠ 'T' va 'F':

     T = TRUE  = to'g'ri
     F = FALSE = noto'g'ri


JAVOBLAR:

  1  F  — Dover ANGLIYADA
           (matnda: 'Dover, on the south
            coast of England')
  2  T  — Folkestone Angliyaning
           janubida (xaritada)
  3  T  — tunnel dengiz TUBI OSTIDAN
           o'tadi (155-bet: '40 metres
           below the seabed')


⚠ 'PRE-' QO'ShIMChASI:

     pre + reading  = o'qishdan OLDIN
     pre + view     = oldindan ko'rish
     pre + pare     = tayyorlamoq

  ⚠ 'pre-' = OLDIN
  ⚠ 'post-' = KEYIN (post-reading)

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (F).

Matnda aniq yozilgan:
'Dover, on the south COAST OF ENGLAND'
= Dover Angliyaning janubiy sohilida.

⚠ Belgiyadagi portlar — Ostend va
Zeebrugge (xaritada ko'rinadi).

tasks.prompt: 2  Folkestone is in the south of England.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (T).

155-betdagi xaritada Folkestone Dover
yonida, Angliyaning janubiy sohilida
turibdi.

⚠ Channel Tunnel aynan Folkestone'dan
boshlanadi.

tasks.prompt: 3  The Channel Tunnel goes under the seabed.
tasks.promptUz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli dengiz tubi ostidan o'tadi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (T).

155-betdagi matnda:
'The Channel Tunnel is 50 km long and
40 METRES BELOW THE SEABED.'

'the seabed' = dengiz tubi
('sea' + 'bed' — 'dengiz to'shagi').

exercises.instructionEn: 2  a) Read the texts and tick (✓) the correct box for the statements 1-6: Right / Wrong / Doesn't Say. Then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  a) Matnlarni o'qing va 1-6 gaplar uchun to'g'ri katakchani belgilang: To'g'ri / Noto'g'ri / Aytilmagan. So'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠⚠ MASHQ IKKI BETGA YOYILGAN:

  1, 2 va 6-gaplar → 154-betdagi
     DOVER matnidan
  3, 4 va 5-gaplar → 155-betdagi
     TUNNEL matni va FAKTLAR QUTISIDAN

  ⚠ Shuning uchun avval IKKALA matnni
  ham o'qing.


⚠⚠ UCH XIL JAVOB — ENG MUHIM MAHORAT:

  RIGHT (to'g'ri)
     Matnda shunday deyilgan.

  WRONG (noto'g'ri)
     Matnda BOShQAChA deyilgan —
     matn gapga QARShI chiqadi.

  DOESN'T SAY (aytilmagan)
     Matnda bu haqda UMUMAN gap yo'q.
     Rost bo'lishi ham, yolg'on bo'lishi
     ham mumkin — LEKIN MATN AYTMAGAN.

  ⚠⚠ ENG KO'P XATO: 'Doesn't Say' o'rniga
  'Wrong' belgilash.

  ⚠ QOIDA: matnda dalil YO'Q bo'lsa —
  'Doesn't Say'. O'zingiz bilgan narsa
  hisobga OLINMAYDI!


DOVER HAQIDAGI MATN (154-bet):

  'Dover, on the south coast of England,
   is one of the world's busiest PORTS.
   Every day lots of FERRIES and
   high-speed catamarans called "Seacats"
   arrive and leave. It's a SHORT trip
   across the English Channel to Calais
   and Dunkirk in France, or to Ostend
   and Zeebrugge in Belgium. A
   TRADITIONAL ferry takes 90 minutes
   from Dover to Calais, but a catamaran
   is much faster and can make the SAME
   journey in 35 minutes.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Angliyaning janubiy sohilidagi Dover —
   dunyodagi eng band portlardan biri. Har
   kuni ko'plab paromlar va "Seacat" deb
   ataladigan tezyurar katamaranlar kelib-
   ketadi. La-Mansh bo'g'ozi orqali
   Fransiyaning Kale va Dyunkerk shaharlariga
   yoki Belgiyaning Ostend va Zeebrugge
   shaharlariga qisqa sayohat. An'anaviy
   parom Doverdan Kalega 90 daqiqada boradi,
   lekin katamaran ancha tezroq va xuddi shu
   yo'lni 35 daqiqada bosib o'tadi.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  WRONG        (parom 90 daqiqa)
  2  RIGHT        (Seacat — katamaran)
  3  WRONG        (50 km UZUN, 40 metr
                   chuqur)
  4  DOESN'T SAY  (qaysi usul eng ommabop
                   ekani aytilmagan)
  5  WRONG        (1994-yilda ochilgan)
  6  RIGHT        (Ostend — Belgiyada)


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2a ning ikkinchi
  qismi):

  154-betda:
     Tunnel   = tunnel
     ports    = portlar
     ferries  = paromlar

  155-betda:
     seabed      = dengiz tubi
     expensive   = qimmat
     sightseeing = diqqatga sazovor
                   joylarni tomosha qilish

tasks.prompt: 1  It takes 35 minutes to travel from Dover to Calais by ferry.
tasks.promptUz: Doverdan Kalega parom bilan borish 35 daqiqa vaqt oladi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong).

Matnda:
'A traditional FERRY takes 90 MINUTES
from Dover to Calais, but a CATAMARAN
... in 35 MINUTES.'

⚠ TUZOQ: 35 daqiqa raqami matnda BOR,
lekin u KATAMARAN uchun, parom uchun emas!

⚠ Bunday tuzoqqa e'tibor bering: raqam
to'g'ri, lekin BOSHQA narsaga tegishli.

tasks.prompt: 2  A Seacat is a high-speed catamaran.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (Right).

Matnda:
'high-speed catamarans CALLED "Seacats"'
= 'Seacat' deb ataladigan tezyurar
katamaranlar.

⚠ 'called' = deb ataladigan — nom berish
uchun ishlatiladi.

tasks.prompt: 3  The Channel Tunnel is 50km below the seabed.
tasks.promptUz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli dengiz tubidan 50 km pastda.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong). Javob 155-betdagi
matnda:

'The Channel Tunnel is 50 KM LONG and
40 METRES BELOW the seabed.'

⚠ TUZOQ: 50 km — UZUNLIGI, chuqurligi
emas! Chuqurligi — 40 METR.

⚠ Ikki o'lchov ATAYLAB almashtirilgan.

tasks.prompt: 4  The most popular way to cross the Channel is by Seacat.
tasks.promptUz: Bo'g'ozdan o'tishning eng ommabop usuli — Seacat.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠⚠ AYTILMAGAN (Doesn't Say) — bu betdagi
ENG QIYIN band!

Ikkala matnda ham Seacat, parom va tunnel
TASVIRLANGAN, lekin QAYSI BIRI ENG OMMABOP
ekani HECH QAYERDA aytilmagan.

⚠ 'Wrong' deb belgilash — XATO. 'Wrong'
faqat matn gapga QARSHI chiqqanda
qo'yiladi.

⚠ QOIDA: matnda dalil yo'q → 'Doesn't Say'.

⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong). Javob 155-betdagi
FAKTLAR QUTISIDA:

'Since it opened in 1994, 57 million
people ... have travelled through the
Channel Tunnel.'

⚠ 1994-yil, 1995 emas.

⚠ E'TIBOR: javob asosiy matnda emas,
KICHIK QUTIDA yashiringan. Bunday
qutilarni ham o'qish kerak!

⚠ TO'G'RI (Right).

Matnda:
'... or to OSTEND and Zeebrugge in
BELGIUM.'

⚠ 155-betdagi xaritada ham Ostend
Belgiya hududida ko'rsatilgan —
ikki manbadan tasdiqlanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: 2  b) Match the highlighted words to their opposites in the list: boring, long, different, modern, slower.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  b) Ta'kidlangan so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi zid ma'noli so'zlar bilan moslang: boring, long, different, modern, slower.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ TA'KIDLANGAN (ko'k rangda) SO'ZLAR
IKKI BETGA TARQALGAN:

  154-betda: short, traditional, same
  155-betda: quicker, exciting

  Ro'yxatda ham AYNAN 5 ta so'z bor —
  demak har biriga bittadan juft.


⚠ ZID MA'NOLI SO'Z = 'AN OPPOSITE'
  (yoki 'an antonym')


BARCHA JUFTLAR:

  short       ↔  long        (qisqa/uzun)
  traditional ↔  modern      (an'anaviy/
                              zamonaviy)
  same        ↔  different   (bir xil/
                              boshqa)
  quicker     ↔  slower      (tezroq/
                              sekinroq)
  exciting    ↔  boring      (qiziqarli/
                              zerikarli)


⚠ IKKI JUFT — QIYOSIY DARAJADA:

     'quicker' va 'slower'

  Ikkalasi ham '-ER' bilan tugaydi —
  QIYOSIY DARAJA (taqqoslash).

  ⚠ Shuning uchun javob ham '-er' bilan
  bo'lishi kerak:
     quicker ↔ slowER  ✓
     quicker ↔ slow    ✗


⚠ ZID MA'NO YASASHNING IKKI YO'LI:

  1) BUTUNLAY BOShQA SO'Z:
     short ↔ long
     same  ↔ different

  2) INKOR QO'ShIMChASI:
     possible  ↔ IMpossible
     happy     ↔ UNhappy
     polite    ↔ IMpolite
     correct   ↔ INcorrect

  ⚠ Bu betdagi barcha juftlar 1-turdan.

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 2: If you don't like boats, why not go on a journey under the sea?
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN: Kemani yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan sayohat qilsangiz-chi?
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 1-MAVZUNING IKKINChI BETI.

  Bu yerda IKKINChI MATN (tunnel haqida),
  XARITA va FAKTLAR QUTISI bor.

  ⚠ 154-betdagi 2a va 2b mashqlarining
  javoblari qisman shu betda.


IKKINChI MATN:

  'If you don't like boats, why not go on
   a journey under the sea? The Channel
   Tunnel is 50 km long and 40 metres
   below the SEABED. Getting from the
   port at Folkestone across to Coquelles
   near Calais is only a 35-minute train
   journey through the tunnel. It's more
   EXPENSIVE than a ferry, but QUICKER
   and much more EXCITING. Thanks to the
   Channel Tunnel, it is now possible to
   spend the day in Paris shopping and
   SIGHTSEEING, and be back in London in
   time for dinner in the evening!'


TARJIMASI:

  'Kemalarni yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan
   sayohat qilsangiz-chi? Bo'g'oz osti
   tunneli 50 km uzunlikda va dengiz tubidan
   40 metr pastda joylashgan. Folkeston
   portidan Kale yaqinidagi Kokellga o'tish —
   tunnel orqali atigi 35 daqiqalik poyezd
   safari. Bu paromdan qimmatroq, lekin
   tezroq va ancha qiziqarliroq. Bo'g'oz osti
   tunneli tufayli endi kunni Parijda xarid
   qilib va shahar tomosha qilib o'tkazish
   hamda kechki ovqatga ulgurib Londonga
   qaytish mumkin!'


FAKTLAR QUTISI:

  'Since it opened in 1994, 57 million
   people and 12,000 cats and dogs have
   travelled through the Channel Tunnel.'

  = '1994-yilda ochilganidan beri tunnel
     orqali 57 million odam va 12 000 mushuk
     va it sayohat qilgan.'

  ⚠ Bu quti 154-betdagi 5-gapning javobi:
  tunnel 1994-yilda ochilgan (1995 EMAS).

  ⚠ HALOL IZOH: '57 million' raqami kitob
  yozilgan davrga tegishli — yillar o'tishi
  bilan bu son ortib boradi.


⚠⚠ 'SINCE' + PRESENT PERFECT:

  'SINCE it opened in 1994, 57 million
   people HAVE TRAVELLED ...'

  ⚠ 'since' (... dan beri) — o'tmishda
  boshlanib, HOZIRGACHA davom etayotgan
  davr.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun fe'l PRESENT PERFECT
  ('have/has + 3-shakl'):
     'have TRAVELLED'  ✓
     'travelled'       ✗ (Past Simple)

  ⚠ 'SINCE' va 'FOR' farqi:
     SINCE + BOShLANISh NUQTASI
        since 1994, since Monday
     FOR   + DAVOMIYLIK
        for 30 years, for two hours


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2a mashqining
  ikkinchi qismi — 'explain the words in
  bold'):

  seabed
     'sea' + 'bed' = dengiz TUBI
     ⚠ 'bed' bu yerda 'to'shak' emas,
     'tub, yotoq' ma'nosida.

  expensive
     = qimmat
     ⚠ zid ma'nosi: 'cheap' (arzon)

  sightseeing
     'sight' + 'seeing' = diqqatga
     sazovor joylarni tomosha qilish
     ⚠ 'to go sightseeing' = shahar
     tomosha qilgani bormoq

  154-betdagi qalin so'zlar:
     Tunnel  = tunnel
     ports   = portlar
     ferries = paromlar


⚠ XARITADAGI JOYLAR:

  ANGLIYA (England):
     London      — poytaxt
     Folkestone  — tunnel boshlanadigan port
     Dover       — parom porti

  FRANSIYA (France):
     Coquelles   — tunnel chiqadigan joy
     Calais      — Kale porti
     Dunkirk     — Dyunkerk porti

  BELGIYA (Belgium):
     Ostend      — port
     Zeebrugge   — port

  ⚠ TUNNEL: Folkestone ↔ Coquelles
  ⚠ PAROM:  Dover ↔ Calais / Dunkirk /
            Ostend / Zeebrugge

  ⚠ E'TIBOR BERING: tunnel Doverdan EMAS,
  FOLKESTONE dan boshlanadi!


⚠ KOMPAS (xaritadagi):

  16 ta rumb ko'rsatilgan:
     N, NNE, NE, ENE, E, ESE, SE, SSE,
     S, SSW, SW, WSW, W, WNW, NW, NNW

  ⚠ 'NNE' = North-North-East
     (shimol-shimoli-sharq)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the seabed   = dengiz tubi
  expensive    = qimmat
  cheap        = arzon
  sightseeing  = shahar tomoshasi
  a tunnel     = tunnel
  since        = ... dan beri
  possible     = mumkin
  thanks to    = ... tufayli
  in time for  = ... ga ulgurib
  to spend the day = kunni o'tkazmoq

tasks.en: READING TEXT 2: If you don't like boats, why not go on a journey under the sea?
tasks.uz: 2-MATN: Kemani yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan sayohat qilsangiz-chi?

tasks.en: If you don't like boats, why not go on a journey under the sea?
tasks.uz: Kemalarni yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan sayohat qilsangiz-chi?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to go ON a journey' — 'on' bilan.

⚠ 'a journey' = safar (uzunroq);
'a trip' = sayohat (qisqaroq).

⚠ 'Why not + fe'l' — taklif ('you' yo'q).

tasks.en: The Channel Tunnel is 50 km long and 40 metres below the seabed.
tasks.uz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli 50 km uzunlikda va dengiz tubidan 40 metr pastda.
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ 154-betdagi 3-gapning javobi shu yerda!

50 km — UZUNLIGI ('long'),
40 metr — ChUQURLIGI ('below the seabed').

⚠ O'lchov + sifat tartibi:
  '50 km LONG'  ✓  (raqam oldin, sifat keyin)
  'long 50 km'  ✗

'the seabed' = 'sea' + 'bed' = dengiz tubi.

tasks.en: Getting from Folkestone to Coquelles is only a 35-minute train journey.
tasks.uz: Folkestondan Kokellga o'tish — atigi 35 daqiqalik poyezd safari.
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ 'a 35-MINUTE journey' — 'minuteS' EMAS!

Ot oldidan sifat bo'lib kelganda o'lchov
BIRLIKDA qoladi va DEFIS qo'yiladi:
  'a 35-minute journey'   ✓
  'a 35-minutes journey'  ✗

⚠ Solishtiring: 'The journey takes 35
MINUTES.' (bu yerda ko'plikda)

⚠ Tunnel FOLKESTONE dan boshlanadi,
Doverdan emas!

tasks.en: It's more expensive than a ferry, but quicker and much more exciting.
tasks.uz: Bu paromdan qimmatroq, lekin tezroq va ancha qiziqarliroq.
tasks.note:
⚠ QIYOSIY DARAJANING IKKI YO'LI shu bitta
gapda:
  UZUN sifat → 'MORE expensive',
                'MORE exciting'
  QISQA sifat → 'quickER'

⚠ 'MUCH more exciting' — 'much' qiyosiy
darajani kuchaytiradi ('very' EMAS!).

⚠ 'expensive' va 'exciting' — 2b mashqidagi
ta'kidlangan so'zlar.

tasks.en: Thanks to the Channel Tunnel, it is now possible to spend the day in Paris.
tasks.uz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli tufayli endi kunni Parijda o'tkazish mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'THANKS TO' = ... tufayli (YAXSHI natija).

⚠ Yomon natija uchun 'BECAUSE OF':
'Because of the rain, we stayed at home.'

⚠ 'it is possible TO + fe'l' — qolip.

'to spend the day' = kunni o'tkazmoq.

tasks.en: ... and be back in London in time for dinner in the evening!
tasks.uz: ... va kechki ovqatga ulgurib Londonga qaytish!
tasks.note:
⚠⚠ 'IN TIME' va 'ON TIME' FARQI:

exercises.instructionEn: Speaking:  • What type of transport do you prefer and why?  • Do you have any ports or long tunnels in your country? Talk about them.
exercises.instructionUz: Gapirish:  • Qanday transport turini afzal ko'rasiz va nega?  • Sizning mamlakatingizda port yoki uzun tunnellar bormi? Ular haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'SPEAKING' — GAPIRISh MAShQI.

  Yozma javob talab qilinmaydi — ovoz
  chiqarib gapiriladi.


BIRINChI SAVOL:
  'What type of transport do you prefer
   and why?'

  ⚠ 'to prefer' = afzal ko'rmoq
  ⚠ 'prefer' da 'r' IKKILANADI:
     preferRED, preferRING
     (urg'u oxirgi bo'g'inda)

  JAVOB QOLIPI:
     'I prefer travelling by [transport]
      because it is [sabab].'

  NAMUNA:
     'I prefer travelling by train because
      it is comfortable and you can see
      the countryside. I don't like flying
      because it is expensive.'

  ⚠ 'prefer' dan keyin IKKI ShAKL mumkin:
     'I prefer TRAVELLING by train.'
     'I prefer TO TRAVEL by train.'


IKKINChI SAVOL:
  'Do you have any ports or long tunnels
   in your country? Talk about them.'

  ⚠ O'ZBEKISTON HAQIDA JAVOB:

  PORT:
     ⚠ O'zbekiston — DENGIZGA ChIQIShI YO'Q
     mamlakat ('a landlocked country').
     Shuning uchun dengiz porti YO'Q.

     JAVOB QOLIPI:
     'Uzbekistan is a landlocked country,
      so we don't have any sea ports.
      We have airports instead - the
      biggest one is in Tashkent.'

  TUNNEL:
     ⚠ O'zbekistonda tog' yo'llarida
     tunnellar bor (masalan, Qamchiq
     dovonidagi tunnel).

     JAVOB QOLIPI:
     'We have mountain tunnels in
      Uzbekistan. There is a long railway
      tunnel at the Kamchik Pass. It
      connects the Fergana Valley with
      the rest of the country.'

  ⚠ 'landlocked' = quruqlik bilan o'ralgan,
  dengizga chiqishi yo'q.


⚠ MUHOKAMA UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  'I prefer ... because ...'
  'In my opinion, ...'   = menimcha
  'I think ...'          = o'ylaymanki
  'For example, ...'     = masalan
  'On the other hand, ...' = boshqa tomondan


⚠ TRANSPORT TURLARI:

     by train  = poyezdda
     by plane  = samolyotda
     by car    = mashinada
     by bus    = avtobusda
     by boat   = kema bilan
     by bike   = velosipedda
     on foot   = piyoda  ⚠ ('by' EMAS!)

tasks.note:
⚠ 'to prefer' = afzal ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'r' IKKILANADI: preferRED, preferRING.

⚠ Ikki shakl ham to'g'ri:

  'I prefer TO TRAVEL by train.'

tasks.en: I prefer travelling by train because it is cheaper and more comfortable than flying.
tasks.uz: Men poyezdda sayohat qilishni afzal ko'raman, chunki u samolyotdan arzonroq va qulayroq.
tasks.note:
⚠ NAMUNA JAVOB.

⚠ 'because' bilan SABAB berish shart —
savolda 'and why?' deb so'ralgan.

⚠ 'cheapER', 'MORE comfortable' — qiyosiy
darajaning ikki yo'li.

tasks.en: Do you have any ports or long tunnels in your country?
tasks.uz: Sizning mamlakatingizda port yoki uzun tunnellar bormi?
tasks.note:
⚠ SAVOLDA 'ANY' — inkor va so'roq gaplarda
('some' — tasdiq gaplarda).

'Do you have ANY ports?'  ✓
'We have SOME tunnels.'   ✓

tasks.en: Uzbekistan is a landlocked country, so we don't have any sea ports.
tasks.uz: O'zbekiston — dengizga chiqishi yo'q mamlakat, shuning uchun bizda dengiz portlari yo'q.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'landlocked' = quruqlik bilan o'ralgan
('land' + 'locked' — 'quruqlikka qulflangan').

⚠ O'zbekiston — dunyodagi kam sonli IKKI
KARRA landlocked mamlakatlardan biri
(qo'shnilarining ham dengizga chiqishi yo'q).

⚠ 'so' = shuning uchun (natija).

tasks.en: There is a long railway tunnel at the Kamchik Pass.
tasks.uz: Qamchiq dovonida uzun temir yo'l tunneli bor.

exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YANGI BO'LIM MUQOVASI.

  Photo File Section 144-bet bilan
  tugadi. Endi yangi bo'lim boshlanadi:

     CULTURE CLIPS

  Betda mashq ham, bet raqami ham yo'q.


⚠ 'CULTURE CLIPS' NIMA DEGANI:

  'culture'  = madaniyat
  'a clip'   = qisqa lavha, parcha

  Ya'ni: MADANIYAT LAVhALARI —
  turli xalqlar hayotidan qisqa
  hikoyalar.

  ⚠ 'a clip' ning boshqa ma'nolari:
     • qisqichcha (qog'oz qisqichi)
     • video lavha ('a video clip')
     • qirqmoq ('to clip')

  ⚠ Bu yerda — VIDEO LAVhA ma'nosida:
  qisqa, qiziqarli parcha.


MUQOVADAGI TO'RT TASVIR:

  1) XITOY PAGODASI
     Ko'p qavatli ibodatxona-minora.
     Qayrilgan cherepitsali tomlar, qizil
     yog'och devorlar, eshik ustida
     xitoycha yozuv.
     → O'ZGA MADANIYAT

  2) DENGIZ KOMPASI
     Rumbalari ko'rinadi: N, NE, E, SE,
     S, SW, W, NW.
     → YO'NALISh, SAYOhAT

  3) TEZYURAR PAROM
     Bortida 'Stena Line' va 'LYNX'.
     → SAYOhAT, DENGIZ

  4) SALYUTLAR
     Oq-ko'k uchqunlar.
     → BAYRAM

  ⚠ To'rt tasvir birgalikda bo'lim
  mavzusini ochadi: sayohat, bayram va
  o'zga xalqlar hayoti.


⚠ KOMPAS RUMBALARI (muqovadan):

     N   = North      = shimol
     S   = South      = janub
     E   = East       = sharq
     W   = West       = g'arb

     NE  = North-East = shimoli-sharq
     SE  = South-East = janubi-sharq
     SW  = South-West = janubi-g'arb
     NW  = North-West = shimoli-g'arb

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida SHIMOL-JANUB oldin,
  SHARQ-G'ARB keyin aytiladi:
     'north-east'  ✓
     'east-north'  ✗

  ⚠ Tomon nomlaridan sifat yasaladi:
     north → NORTHERN (shimoliy)
     south → SOUTHERN (janubiy)
     east  → EASTERN  (sharqiy)
     west  → WESTERN  (g'arbiy)

  ⚠ 142-betda 'northern Belgium' iborasi
  shundan.


⚠ 'STENA LINE' va 'LYNX':

  'Stena Line' — Shvetsiya-Britaniya
  parom kompaniyasi.

  'Lynx' — uning tezyurar katamaranlari
  nomi.

  ⚠ 'a lynx' = silovsin (yovvoyi mushuk).
  Kemalarga tezlik va chaqqonlikni
  bildirish uchun hayvon nomi berilgan.

  ⚠ 'a ferry' = parom (odam va mashina
  tashuvchi kema).


COURSEBOOK'NING QO'ShIMChA BO'LIMLARI:

  116-bet      Irregular Verbs
                 (111 ta noto'g'ri fe'l)
  119-124-bet  Word List
                 (unit bo'yicha so'zlar)
  131-144-bet  Photo File Section
                 (rangli rasmli varaqlar)
  shu bo'lim   Culture Clips
                 (madaniyat lavhalari)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  culture     = madaniyat
  cultural    = madaniy
  a clip      = qisqa lavha; qisqichcha
  a pagoda    = pagoda (xitoy minorasi)
  a compass   = kompas
  a ferry     = parom
  fireworks   = salyut, mushakbozlik
  north       = shimol
  south       = janub
  east        = sharq
  west        = g'arb
  a lynx      = silovsin
